Assistant Manager – Art Job at AM Consulting




        
    

        
        AM Consulting is an indigenous HR Recruitment and consulting firm located in Lagos, Nigeria.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Assistant Manager – Art

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Role Summary


	Lead the development and execution of compelling visual communication across campaigns and digital platforms, ensuring creative excellence, brand consistency, and effective team delivery.


Key Deliverables & Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Develop visual concepts, creative territories, mood boards, and campaign routes from briefs.
	Lead design execution across digital, social, print and other campaign touchpoints.
	Review and refine creative output to maintain strong design quality, visual consistency and brand standards.
	Collaborate with Content, Strategy, Account and Production teams to develop integrated campaigns.
	Direct relevant photoshoots, productions and creative executions where required.
	Guide, coach and review junior creatives while coordinating workload and delivery.
	Drive creative innovation through emerging design trends, technologies and AI-enabled tools.
	Support creative presentations, client reviews and delivery of projects within agreed timelines.


Requirements & Competencies


	Strong art direction, graphic design, visualization and concept development skills.
	Strong portfolio and 5+ years of relevant experience required.
	Creative, detail-oriented and commercially aware, with strong leadership, collaboration and problem-solving abilities.
	Proficient in Photoshop, Illustrator and InDesign; After Effects, Figma and AI tools


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as subject of the mail.

Video Editor Job at DM Holdings (DMH)




        
    

        
        DM Holdings (DMH) is a conglomerate of companies with vast interests in the entertainment and Media business. With each of the subsidiaries’ enviable track records, DMH is poised to take a strategic position in providing cutting-edge services within the Media/Marketing Communication landscape.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Video Editor
Job Location: Ojodu Berger, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Key Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Ensure proper framing, composition, and brand consistency.
	Edit raw footage into polished final videos using industry-standard software such as Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, etc.
	Ensure all outputs meet brand guidelines and deadlines.
	Review and revise videos based on feedback.
	Maintain organized video files and an accessible media archive.


Qualifications & Skills


	Bachelor's Degree with 2 - 4 years of proven experience as a videographer and video editor; portfolio required.
	Proficiency in video editing software: Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve.
	Strong knowledge of lighting, sound, cinematography, and visual storytelling principles.
	Excellent time-management skills to handle multiple projects simultaneously.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using "Video Editor – [Your Location]" as the subject of the email.

{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Administrative Specialist",
  "description": "PalmPay is an Africa-focused fintech firm, launched in 2019. PalmPay is a mobile payments platform that offers a number of financial services.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Administrative Specialist
Job Locations: Lagos
Employment Type: Contract

Description


	We&rsquo;re looking for an Administrative Specialist who is passionate about our mission of driving financial inclusion in Africa.
	The ideal candidate for this role should have a good understanding of business functions, good communication skills, good interpersonal skills and good organizational skills.


Duties &amp; Responsibilities


	Plan and coordinate administrative procedures and systems and devise ways to streamline processes.
	Ensure the smooth and adequate flow of information within the company to facilitate other business operations.
	Manage schedules and deadlines.
	Monitor inventory of office supplies and the purchasing of new material with attention to budgetary constraints.
	Monitor costs and expenses to assist in budget preparation.
	Oversee facilities services, maintenance activities and tradespersons (e.g., electricians).
	Organize and take charge of other office activities (recycling, renovations, event planning etc.).
	Ensure operations adhere to policies and regulations.
	Keep abreast of all organizational changes and business developments.
	Provide Chinese / mandarin translation services between expats when needed.


Requirements


	Minimum of HND in business administration or related field.
	3-5 years of administrative experience.
	Familiarity with financial and facilities management principles.
	Familiarity with creating administrative policies and procedures.
	Very good understanding of office management processes.
